title: hyperverse
description: The totality of worlds together with the structural medium (the Wood) in which they are embedded — the ambient category whose objects include both worlds and the mediating Wood. The multiverse is its subcategory of worlds (the population alone); the hyperverse emphasizes that the inter-world fabric is itself an object of study.

worlds.description: the population of worlds (the multiverse subcategory)

medium.description: the Wood mediating the worlds — the inter-world fabric included as an object
